Introduction.title: Introduction
Introduction.description: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) is a powerful JavaScript library for creating high-performance animations.
Introduction.alert: Important: GSAP works in all modern browsers and is optimized for performance.

Installation.title: Installation
Installation.description: You can install GSAP via npm, yarn, or use a CDN.
Installation.alert: Tip: When working with React, it's better to use npm for smoother integration.

Basic.title: Basic
Basic.alert: All GSAP methods have many parameters for fine-tuning animations.
Basic.toDescription: Changes element properties from current values to the specified ones.
Basic.fromDescription: Animation starts from specified values to the current state.
Basic.fromToMethod: gsap.fromTo() / Animate from start to end state
Basic.fromToDescription: Allows specifying both starting and ending values of the animation.
Basic.setDescription: Instantly sets element properties without animation.
Basic.timelineDescription: Timeline allows combining multiple animations in sequence, controlling time, repeat, and yoyo effects.
